newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Transcom to list on NASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Transcom to list on NASDAQ.

text.p: Australian gas technology developer Transcom International Ltd said on Wednesday it had received approval for listing on the NASDAQ stock market with trading to start on September 30.

Managing director Peter Malone said in a statement the NASDAQ listing would provide Transcom with a expanded market for its securities and an enhanced profile with potential users of its electronic control systems technology in the areas of natural gas vehicle systems and wireless data communications.
Three U.S. stockbroking firms in New York, Bankers Trust, Herzog Heine Geduld and Troster Singer, have confirmed with NASDAQ as official company stockbrokers, Malone said.

One Transcom American share will equal 50 Australian shares in accordance with NASDAQ listing requirements, he said. At 1.25 p.m. (0325 GMT), Transcom shares were 0.005 cents up at 13.5 cents. It has a market capitalisation of A$31.41 million.
